hero.title: Sandos
hero.subtitle: Open admin.html to change this text, add a background image, and build the containers below.

sections.title: Image on the left
sections.text:
Each container picks a layout from a dropdown in the admin page. Upload images into the slots and write your text.

Leave a blank line between paragraphs.

sections.title: Two images, text below
sections.text: Containers can be reordered, deleted, or switched to a different layout at any time.

sections.title: One big image, two small ones
sections.text: Empty image slots show a placeholder until you upload something.
